gap.title: Government furnished property held by the shipbuilder for this hull
gap.executor: PIEE GFP Module role holder or SUPSHIP Newport News
gap.note: BEST RATIO IN THE REGISTER. Existing report, defined key (CAGE 43689 scoped to both PIIDs), mandated seven-business-day cadence, no new access path. GAO-25-106868 names SUPSHIP as not consistently verifying contractor property records, so this is the local test of a department-wide weakness standing since FY2001.
